Mašina, kuri deda kompiuterio žodžius ant popieriaus.
A machine that puts the computer's words onto paper.
In the office stand two printers.

Kompiuterio dokumentas su žodžiais ar nuotrauka.
A computer document with words or a photograph.
I opened the file on the computer.

Mažas daiktas failams; jį dedame į kompiuterį.
A small thing for files; we put it into the computer.
My files are on the flash drive.

Pinigai, kuriuos darbuotojas gauna kas mėnesį už darbą.
Money that a worker gets every month for work.
For work I get a good salary.

Pinigai, kuriuos darbdavys moka už darbą pagal sutartį.
Money that an employer pays for work according to a contract.
The director pays a good wage.

Pinigai žmogui, kuris nebedirba dėl senatvės.
Money for a person who no longer works because of old age.
Grandfather lives on a pension.

Pinigai, kuriuos gauna bedarbis ar ligonis.
Money that an unemployed or a sick person gets.
The family gets a benefit for the children.

Pinigai studentui, kuris gerai mokosi.
Money for a student who studies well.
The son gets a scholarship at the university.

Kai nedirbame ir darome tai, kas mums patinka.
When we do not work and do what pleases us.
During leisure I watch films.

Šeštadienis ir sekmadienis, kai nereikia dirbti.
Saturday and Sunday, when there is no need to work.
This weekend we drive to the village.

Nedirbti ir gulėti ar sėdėti po darbo.
Not to work and to lie or sit after work.
After lunch mother rests.

Ilgai nedirbti ir ilsėtis, dažnai prie jūros.
Not to work for a long time and to rest, often by the sea.
In summer the parents are on holiday by the sea.

Sakyti žodžius su muzika; taip daro choras.
To say words with music; that is what a choir does.
The children sing at school.

Daryti nuotrauką aparatu ar telefonu.
To make a photograph with a camera or a telephone.
The tourists photograph the old town.

Aparatu daryti judantį vaizdą, kurį po to žiūrime.
With a camera to make a moving picture that we watch afterwards.
Father films the children in the yard.

Daryti muziką; taip dirba orkestras.
To make music; that is what an orchestra does.
The brother plays in the orchestra.

Per atostogas važiuoti ar skristi į naujas šalis ir miestus.
During the holidays to drive or fly to new countries and cities.
They travel around Europe.

Rinkti ir laikyti daug daiktų, pavyzdžiui, monetų.
To gather and keep many things, for example coins.
The son collects old coins.

Iš siūlų daryti šiltus drabužius.
From threads to make warm clothes.
Grandmother knits by the television.

Ranka daryti paveikslą ant popieriaus.
By hand to make a picture on paper.
The child draws a house and a tree.

Žiūrėti į žodžius knygoje ir juos suprasti.
To look at the words in a book and understand them.
In the evening I read a book in bed.

Bėgioti, plaukti ar žaisti kamuoliu.
To jog, to swim or to play with a ball.
In the mornings he does sports in the stadium.

Sėdėti prie ežero ir laukti žuvies.
To sit by the lake and wait for a fish.
Grandfather fishes by the river.

Vieta, kur žmonės žiūri filmus dideliame ekrane.
A place where people watch films on a big screen.
In the evening we go to the cinema.

Tai, ką girdime, kai groja orkestras ar choras.
That which we hear when an orchestra or a choir plays.
In the evening I listen to music.

Futbolas, krepšinis ar tenisas.
Football, basketball or tennis.
He likes winter sport.

Pastatas su scena, kur dirba aktoriai.
A building with a stage where actors work.
Today we go to the theater.

Daiktas, su kuriuo darome nuotraukas.
A thing with which we make photographs.
The tourist has a big camera.

Aparatas, kuriame girdime muziką ir kalbą.
A device in which we hear music and speech.
In the car we listen to the radio.

Norėti girdėti muziką, radiją ar žmogų.
To want to hear music, the radio or a person.
She listens to music on the telephone.

Aparatas su ekranu; per jį žiūrime filmus.
A device with a screen; through it we watch films.
In the evening we watch the television in the living room.

Laikyti daiktą taip, kad kitas žmogus jį matytų.
To hold a thing so that another person sees it.
The teacher shows a map in the class.

Norėti matyti; taip darome kine ar prie televizoriaus.
To want to see; that is what we do in the cinema or by the television.
In the evening we watch a new film.

Ją įjungiame kompiuteryje, kai norime dirbti ar žaisti.
We turn it on in the computer when we want to work or play.
I work with a new program.

Aparatas, iš kurio girdime muziką ir dainas.
A device from which we hear music and songs.
He turned on the player.

Apvalus daiktas su muzika ar filmu.
A round thing with music or a film.
On the table lie two discs.

Žodžiai su muzika, kuriuos girdime per radiją.
Words with music that we hear on the radio.
The girl knows many songs.

Vakaras, kai orkestras ar choras groja žmonėms.
An evening when an orchestra or a choir plays for people.
The tickets to the concert are expensive.

Spektaklis, kur žmonės šoka pagal muziką.
A performance where people dance to music.
The girl learns to dance in ballet.

Ilgas vaizdas su žmonėmis; jį žiūrime kine.
A long picture with people; we watch it in the cinema.
Yesterday we watched an interesting film.

Spektaklis, kur aktoriai dainuoja su orkestru.
A performance where actors sing with an orchestra.
The parents go to the opera.

Kai aktoriai teatre rodo istoriją.
When actors in a theater show a story.
In the theater we saw a beautiful performance.

Būti kitu žmogumi teatre ar filme.
To be another person in a theater or a film.
The actor acts in a new film.

Popierius; jį perkame, kai einame į kiną.
A paper; we buy it when we go to the cinema.
I buy a ticket to the theater.

Didelis kambarys, kur žmonės žiūri koncertą.
A big room where people watch a concert.
In the concert hall there are many places.

Žmonės stovi vienas už kito ir laukia.
People stand one behind another and wait.
We stand in the line by the cash desk.

Kur kas nors yra – namas, parkas ar kiemas.
Where something is — a house, a park or a yard.
We found a beautiful place by the lake.

Aukšta teatro dalis, kur stovi aktoriai.
The high part of the theater where the actors stand.
On the stage dance the girls.
